::: {#def-squared-prediction-error}
#### Squared prediction error

The **squared prediction error** $\sqprederr$ of a [prediction](#def-prediction) $\fitted$
of an observed outcome $y$ <!-- check-term-links: allow: sds defines only the outcome vector, not a single outcome -->
is the [square](https://morrison-lab.github.io/mds/algebra-basics.html#def-square) of its [prediction error](#def-prediction-error) $\prederr$:

$$\sqprederr \eqdef \sqf{\fitted - y}.$$
:::
